query: Our assistant proposes refunds and includes approved=true in its JSON. Design a trusted admission function that ignores model permission claims and checks authenticated role, amount limits, and current order state.

Two agent workers each propose an allowed transfer, but together they exceed the spending ceiling. Implement atomic cumulative reservation and prove denied proposals leave authoritative balances unchanged.
A model cites an urgent request to waive the minimum inventory reserve. Specify executable invariants, structured deny reasons, and an authorized policy-exception path that prose cannot override.
Audit every route from an LLM proposal to a side effect, including retries, resumed runs, alternate tools, and workers. Put admission immediately before execution and eliminate bypass paths.
Bind a grant for an agent action to principal, resource, canonical arguments, state version, expiry, and use count. Define how trusted code rejects a forged or stale authorization.

An AI assistant calculates loan eligibility and then updates the record. Move consequential calculations and permissions into deterministic code while keeping model interpretation as a typed advisory proposal.
Design the allow, deny, and needs_approval results for proposed account permission changes. Missing facts and policy outages must fail closed; reviewers cannot silently override hard invariants.

The agent received approval for one recipient but changes the destination before sending. Define admission checks and compare-and-set commit logic preventing substitution after the earlier allow decision.

Our scheduling model writes completed directly into the workflow database. Define receipt-backed deterministic state transitions and execution rights so evaluator approval or confident text cannot establish completion.
Implement a model-to-action gate for stock adjustments. Check units, evidence freshness, tenant ownership, current version, and permissions, then issue an auditable receipt only after a valid commit.

Design a readable approval experience for an agent-generated campaign: exact audience preview, evidence, item-level rejection, timeout behavior, and cancellation. The admission policy implementation is already complete.

Compose runtime controls for an assistant using input screening, output grounding, permissions, approvals, and deadlines. Find gaps and contradictory layer behavior; existing admission code stays unchanged.

Threat-model an agent that consumes web pages and can upload documents. Trace indirect injection, credential leakage, confused-deputy risks, and destination restrictions rather than implementing business-rule admission.
Define a JSON proposal contract for action, refusal, or missing evidence responses. Specify bounded parsing and semantic validation before the existing authorization layer receives the result.
Implement deterministic eligibility calculations for a conventional application form. Inputs arrive through a normal endpoint; there is no LLM proposal or model-to-action trust boundary.
Design an advisory writing assistant that summarizes meeting notes and cannot invoke tools or change application state. Focus on concise production instructions and supported evidence gaps.

Specify memory provenance and checkpoint fields for an assistant. Explain how to retain pending action IDs and state versions across compaction without redesigning the already enforced execution gate.
Build tests asserting the existing executor denies forged approvals, stale versions, and concurrent overdrafts. Use fakes and property cases; no admission implementation changes are requested.
Evaluate two agents on answer correctness, safe abstention, and prohibited trajectory effects. Keep the policy engine fixed and produce a calibrated benchmark and severity-aware release decision.

Review ordinary session-cookie authorization, access control, security headers, and upload validation in a web application. Its backend operates directly on authenticated requests without model proposals.
